candidate_id.description: The candidate_id of the pre-pass candidate this row answers - confirmed or dismissed. Copy it verbatim: the factory compares the ids a report cites with the ids it presented, so a row that names no presented candidate accounts for nothing (agents-w9ni). Omit only when the pre-pass supplied no ids, where the check falls back to counting rows and is reported as count-only.

false_positive.description: True when this candidate was evaluated and REJECTED (a dismissal recorded as evidence, not work). Every candidate the pre-pass supplied must appear in findings, either as a confirmed issue or as a dismissal (agents-f8dj).
